config.scope: first8 predeclared old32 TRAIN parents, all instructions and positive references
config.radius_metric: Euclidean distance from measured current tip; not goal distance or reference arc length
config.boundary: reachable in-radius free nodes with a conservative valid grid edge to an out-of-radius free node
config.adjacency: shared26-neighbor edges; all supercover touched voxels must be free
config.region: connected components of the induced boundary graph, without arbitrary angular splitting
config.node_limit: reject before graph construction if the entire admitted in-radius free-node set exceeds20000
config.reference_mapping: last sqrt(3)*voxel length of the segment before first exact sphere exit; full grid supercover intersects frozen boundary
